title: SimonUHC
description: mod for playing uhc with your friends via LAN. (Essential and e4mc also works)
body:
# SimonUHC

# ⚠️DISCLAIMER⚠️
mod is still WIP.

## what is this for
this mod is mainly made for modpack SimonUHC Client.

## what does it do?
It basically allows you to play uhc game in LAN world with friends. It also works very well with Essential and e4mc.

# how to play

## what you need:
- Minecraft (obviously)
- this mod
- friends

## step by step guide:

- Create a new world
- use `/uhc countdown <seconds>` to set preparation time
- use `/uhc borders <blocks>` to set border size (for example: `/uhc borders 5000` will confine world within -2500 to 2500 x and z cordinates)
- Open it to LAN
- wait for your friends to join you
- (optional) use `/spectators join` to spectate and `/spectators leave` to stop spectating
- use `/uhc init` to start the game.

# FAQ
### Q: I don't have friends
A: Bro so do I 🥀🥀.
